boundary: Polls stay a separate descriptive layer: never a source for election results, seats or party identity; no averages, trends, forecasts or inferred support are computed. The schema and fail-closed validator (src/lib/politicalPolling.ts) exist; no observation is stored.

admission_conditions.condition: Owner-approved amendment of docs/political-data/political_source_policy.md permitting a polling-measurement layer (pending since docs/political-data/polling_measurement_schema_proposal.json).
A source_rights_registry.json entry per publisher whose reviewed terms allow normalized republication of the published figures; canExport() in scripts/legal-security/policy.mjs must return allowed.
The organisation conducting the poll and any commissioner are named; polls commissioned by a party, candidate or campaign are excluded.

Each observation carries fieldwork start and end, publication date, sample size, population, method, question wording, respondent base and undecided treatment, or records them as null with the reason; no value is estimated.
Each reported entity is mapped to a verified party or alliance identity from official election records; a label match alone is refused.
The exact published source is archived with retrieval time and sha256, with its revision status.
Owner approval per publisher (PollingAdmission.ownerApproved with a decision reference).

candidates_for_review.note: Regularly published national poll; reuse terms not reviewed; no host registered.
Regularly published national poll; reuse terms not reviewed; no host registered.

not_reviewed: No polling publisher has been reviewed for Czechia, Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Austria, Romania, Slovenia, Croatia or Serbia. Candidates are listed only as starting points; none is eligible until every condition above is closed.
